In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] made an '''attack''' on a small [[Chubbit]] encampment being used by a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Unidentified Rebel gunrunner|gunrunner]] to sell [[Blaster/Legends|arms]] to the [[Chubbit resistance]]. The [[Human/Legends|Human]] gunrunner and his Chubbit allies attempted to flee, but their escape was only made possible when a man attacked the Imperial forces with a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. The Chubbit resistance fighters and their guest escaped, and the man introduced himself as [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. Nevertheless, he was actually an [[Obi-Wan Kenobi impersonator|imposter]] working for [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].<ref name="CSW10" />
